lines.directed: Don’t confuse that general reference with this particular sixteen-world enumeration.
We’re now giving a specific account of the worlds and presiding powers assigned to the earth principle.
Now, the important point isn’t that you need to memorise sixteen obscure divine names before breakfast.
It’s that even the lowest tattva contains an internally differentiated collection of worlds.
The universe is not merely one homogeneous physical place.
It’s an entire hierarchy of possible experiences and their corresponding divine powers.
